_doc: Multi-enemy Phase 4 QA fixture. A TEST fixture, never production content: it lets a headless test enter a real battle (GameFlow.enter_test_floor) with 2 and then 3 enemy units, so the view stack (UnitLayer, CutHudView, FloorLayer) can be checked with several units on the board. Match 1 = two units (block + pattern), match 2 = three units (block + pattern + a 2x2 pattern boss). The `enemies` entries are RAW: RunConfig.clean_match resolves `ai`, `footprint` and `defense` from them. dev_pattern_dummy and dev_pattern_boss already exist in assets/data/enemy_skills.json as dev entries, so this fixture adds no new game content.
